newsitem.title: FRANCE: Merrill Lynch downgrades French oil stocks - brokers.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch downgrades French oil stocks - brokers.

text.p: Merrill Lynch downgraded its short-term recommendations on shares in French oil companies Elf Aquitaine and Total SA, driving the shares lower, brokers said on Thursday.

They said Merrill lowered its short-term recommendation on Elf to accumulate from buy, but retained its long-term buy recommendation. On Total, the firm cut its short-term rating to neutral from accumulate, but again retained its long-term buy recommendation.
Elf shares were down 2.17 percent at 447.10 francs at 1440 GMT, while Total shares were down 2.26 percent at 414.30 francs.
The bourse's leading CAC-40 index was 0.7 percent higher at the same time.
Merrill Lynch's oil analysts were not immediately available to comment on the rating changes.
